title.en: Story 1 — Fat and Thin at the Station

book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, not from any translation

sentences.ar: اتنين أصحاب من أيام المدرسة التقوا بالمحطة.
sentences.en: Two friends from their school days met at the station.
They embraced and began laughing and remembering.

sentences.ar: سأل الأول: وإنت شو صار معك بالحياة؟
sentences.en: The first asked: and what has become of you in life?

sentences.ar: قال التاني: موظف بسيط، وعندي ولد.
sentences.en: The second said: a small clerk, and I have a son.

sentences.ar: قال الأول باستحياء: صرت مدير عام.
sentences.en: The first said shyly: I have become a director.
His friend’s face changed in an instant.

sentences.ar: صار يقول: يا سيدي، وتشرفنا، وإحنا تحت أمرك.
sentences.en: He began saying: my lord, and honoured, and we are at your service.
The director tried to stop him and could not.
They shook hands with the tips of their fingers.
And each went his own way.

sentences.ar: الصداقة اللي عاشت عشرين سنة ماتت بجملة وحدة.
sentences.en: A friendship of twenty years died in one sentence.
